twi_send_clk_9pulse.evidence: 'twi_send_clk_9pulse','SDA is still Stuck Low': bus recovery with udelay_alias 500/1000/1000/500.

sunxi_twi_write.evidence: adapter write: twi_start 0x3d058, send addr 0x3ce20, send data 0x3ce6c, twi_stop 0x3cfd8.

sunxi_twi_read.evidence: adapter read: start, addr, register byte, twi_restart 0x3d1da, data receive loop, stop.

twi_start.evidence: TWI regs at base: EFR +0x1c=0, SRST? +0x18=1, CNTR +0x0c |= M_STA (0x20), clear INT_FLAG (bit3); poll CNTR bit3 up to 255 iterations (loop 0x3d07a, no timer) -> "START can't sendout!".

twi_send_addr.evidence: DATA +0x08 = addr<<1|rw; CNTR |= 8 then clear bits 4/5; poll CNTR bit3 up to 255 iterations (0x3ce3e); STAT +0x10 expect 0x18 (write) / 0x40 (read).

twi_send_data.evidence: per byte: DATA +0x08, CNTR handshake, poll CNTR bit3 up to 255 (0x3ce9c), STAT expect 0x28.

twi_stop.evidence: 'twi_stop', "i2c state isn't idle(0xf8)", "STOP can't sendout!": sets M_STP, bounded polls of CNTR bit4 and STAT==0xf8.

gpio_read_one_pin_value.evidence: vendor gpio lib: checks pin cfg is input (0x3a20 reads CFG at 0x0300afdc+bank*0x24+4*n), then data via 0x3a38 (ldr [bank*0x24 + 0x0300afec], i.e. 0x0300b010+(bank-1)*0x24; bank 5 = PE -> 0x0300b0a0). Callers: key_boot_recovery 0x33a0 (0x33f6, 0x3462) only.

gpio_port_data_read.evidence: movs r3,#0x24; muls; ldr r3,=0x0300afec; ldr r0,[r0,r3]. Only caller 0x3b0e (gpio_read_one_pin_value).

gpio_write_one_pin_value.evidence: read-modify-write of data reg 0x0300b010+(bank-1)*0x24 (ldr at 0x3b82, str at 0x3b96). Callers: sunxi_mmc_init 0x1be3a/0x1be56, disp gpio 0x20a38, 0x6e9dc.

gpio_set_pin.evidence: vendor gpio set (uses data reg 0x0300b010+bank*0x24 at 0x3c00). Callers 0x43e2, sunxi_mmc_init 0x1be2c/0x1be7a, disp 0x20a18.

gpio_request_set.evidence: vendor gpio_request with cfg/pull/drv/data (literal 0x0300b010 at 0x3ee8). Callers boot_init_gpio 0x29d2/0x29e6, key_boot_recovery 0x33da, mmc host 0x1dfcc/0x1e5be, disp 0x209f2, 0x6ea56.
